Answer: F
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates widening of the right paratracheal stripe, which is a classic radiographic sign of right paratracheal lymphadenopathy. While other masses like bronchogenic cysts can occur in this location, lymphadenopathy is the most common cause of paratracheal fullness and is frequently associated with symptoms like shortness of breath due to underlying systemic or pulmonary pathology.
